newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hirabo up sharply after third-party allotment news.
newsitem.headline: Hirabo up sharply after third-party allotment news.

text.p: The share price of fishing-net maker Hirabo Corp rose sharply in active trade on Tuesday morning after its announcement of a third-party allotment.
By 0127 GMT, Hirabo was up 40 yen, or 13.33 pct, at 340 yen.
Hirabo was the largest percentage gainer on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
It was also the second-most actively traded issue on the second section. Turnover was 629,000 shares.

Hirabo said on Monday that it would issue 7.12 million new shares worth 2.5 billion yen to two unlisted firms belonging to the Chisan group on March 13, with the aim of strengthening its financial condition.
